title: HungerStation promotions
subtitle: Promotions made here and sent to HungerStation, per chain, with each part's answer. Our own pricing never applies them.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the HungerStation promotions grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

results.failedTitle: The promotions could not be loaded

detail.failed: The promotion could not be loaded
detail.notFound: There is no such HungerStation promotion.
detail.allStores: All the chain's stores (frozen when sent)
detail.partsHint: Each part is one promotion on HungerStation's side, under the name shown.
detail.noParts: No part yet: parts are made when the promotion is sent.
detail.unansweredHint: HungerStation has not answered this part in 24 hours. Refresh asks it again.
detail.polling: Waiting for HungerStation’s answer — this re-reads itself.
detail.resendWhileSending: Waits for HungerStation’s answer to this part.

refusals.title: What HungerStation refused
refusals.hint: From HungerStation’s latest answer to each part, per store. Each list copies as it is filtered.
refusals.invalidDiscountedSkus: Promo price above HungerStation’s list price
refusals.copyFailedDetail: Select the rows and copy them by hand.

resend.title: Resend a part
resend.note: Sends <part>{{part}}</part> to HungerStation again, unchanged and under the same identity — for example after the next stock sync has listed a missing material.
resend.doneDetail: {{part}} is sending again; HungerStation’s answer follows on its own.

editor.chainTyped: Type the chain key, or pick one seen on the list.
editor.name: Internal name
editor.displayNameHint: Required. HungerStation shows it to the customer.

windowProblems.incomplete: Enter the start and the end, date and time.
windowProblems.endNotAfterStart: The end must be after the start.

editor.limitInvalid: A whole number of at least 1, or blank.
editor.defaultHint: A row with a blank subtype or value takes it.
editor.storesFrozen: Every HungerStation store of the chain is ticked. The list is frozen when the promotion is sent: a store onboarded later does not join it, and adding stores replaces the promotion.
editor.storesPickChain: Pick a chain to see its stores.
editor.storesFailed: The chain's stores could not be loaded
editor.storesNone: The chain has no HungerStation store.
editor.itemsHint: Our material numbers, never HungerStation's SKU. A paste replaces the items. A grey subtype or value is the default.
editor.itemsOverCap: More than {{max}} materials: split the sheet.
editor.rowsRefused_one: HungerStation would refuse <n>{{n}}</n> row. It is marked below.
editor.rowsRefused_other: HungerStation would refuse <n>{{n}}</n> rows. They are marked below.
editor.stateSaved: Saved as a draft. Nothing has reached HungerStation.
editor.sendNeedsItems: Paste at least one item first.
editor.saveNote: Saving keeps the draft here. Nothing is sent to HungerStation.
editor.sendNote: Sends the promotion to <stores>{{stores}}</stores> stores with <items>{{items}}</items> materials. It reads Sending, and edits wait, until HungerStation answers.
editor.lockedSending: HungerStation has not answered yet. Edits wait until it does.
editor.lockedSent: This promotion has been sent. Only a draft is edited here.

import.title: Paste the strikethrough items
import.format: One material per line, its columns separated by tabs as Excel copies them: material, subtype (PERCENTAGE, ABSOLUTE or FINAL_PRICE), value, max quantity. A blank subtype or value takes the default discount. A header row is skipped.
import.headerSkipped: The first line was read as a header and skipped: <header>{{header}}</header>
import.repeats_one: <n>{{n}}</n> repeated material: its last row is kept.
import.repeats_other: <n>{{n}}</n> repeated materials: each keeps its last row.
import.overCap: <n>{{n}}</n> materials is more than HungerStation takes in one promotion (<max>{{max}}</max>). Split the sheet.
import.paste: Or paste the rows (straight from Excel)
import.readFailed: The file could not be read as text. In Excel, save it as "Unicode Text" and pick it again, or paste its rows.
import.blocked_one: <n>{{n}}</n> line cannot be read. Fix it to use the paste.
import.blocked_other: <n>{{n}}</n> lines cannot be read. Fix them to use the paste.
import.failedTitle: The paste could not be used

problem.columnCount_one: This line has {{count}} column; it takes at most {{expected}}.
problem.columnCount_other: This line has {{count}} columns; it takes at most {{expected}}.

cell.subtype: The subtype is not PERCENTAGE, ABSOLUTE or FINAL_PRICE.
cell.value: The value is not a number.
cell.maxQuantity: The max quantity is not a whole number.
